challenge.method: Compared the meta path passage with the cache and import hook context. Ran python-controls.py with CPython 3.13.5 using synthetic local modules and spy finders. Challenged first-spec stopping, exhaustion, an explicit finder ModuleNotFoundError, another finder exception, two cache forms, and three parent-package cases.
challenge.results: Finders executed in list order and stopped on the first spec. Exhaustion raised ModuleNotFoundError and both finder exceptions propagated unchanged. Cache presence and a None cache marker bypassed finders. A missing parent or missing __path__ prevented child search, whereas a valid parent supplied its exact path object to the child finder.

limitations: The execution controls used CPython 3.13.5 as a supplement to the exact pinned Python 3.13.0 reference. The result applies after the named search begins and ends at the finder stage.
